name: Sephora Credit Card
reviewNotes: This entry represents the closed-loop Sephora Credit Card requested by name. Sephora also issues separate Visa and Visa Signature products, and applicants cannot select which product they receive; the user's physical product must be confirmed before an upstream PR is opened. There is no annual fee. The 4% rewards program and Beauty Insider points are purchase-derived earnings, while the first-purchase discount and initial outside-spend offer are signup benefits, so none are recurring tracked benefits. Global synchronization disposition: create card:sephora-credit-card; there are no benefit definitions, statuses, or Benefit Usage Guide links to propagate. A local image is deferred until the exact physical variant is confirmed; imageUrl records the intended future path only.
